The site has no terms of service, no privacy policy and no named operator, and does not promise a payout deadline.

summary.en: A creator network that pays for validated views on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube short-form video, unrelated to the African cliptocash.io despite the identical name. Its terms set out the earning rules exactly: a campaign RPM per 1,000 views, a 1,000-view threshold, a 125,000-view cap per video that no campaign can raise, a 30-day counting window and a 7-day submission window. Earnings are paid every Monday via Stripe or Whop; the minimum payout amount is not published.
